table:
| Package | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| entcascade | Generate cascade delete functions from schema annotations |
| entgqlmulti | Generate per-API GraphQL schemas from a single ent schema |
| entpoly | Laravel-style polymorphic relationships — MorphTo / MorphOne / MorphMany / MorphedByMany with compile-time + DB-level type safety + GraphQL union surface |
| entreadonly | Make a schema read-only at codegen — strips Create/Update/Delete builders so writes fail to compile, while edges + queries + GraphQL stay intact |
| entskiptable | Exclude externally-owned tables from ent auto-migration via a composable migration DiffHook (no DDL on tables you only read) |
| enttui | Schema-driven terminal UI / admin browser for ent — a `k9s`-style keyboard-driven data explorer generated straight from your schema |
